## Purpose

Describe the problem and the exact change.

## Change class

- [ ] Editorial
- [ ] Clarifying
- [ ] Additive
- [ ] Breaking

## Authority impact

- [ ] Normative prose
- [ ] Machine policy or schema
- [ ] Reference implementation
- [ ] Conformance suite
- [ ] Documentation only

## Verification

- [ ] Conformance suite passes
- [ ] New or changed requirements have tests
- [ ] Version impact is documented
- [ ] No implementation choice is represented as normative without justification
- [ ] Privacy and safety impacts were considered

## Evidence and compatibility

Provide evidence references, affected controls, compatibility analysis, and unresolved questions.
